name: toolbox
description: Tuck's Claude Code plugins. Install only the plugins you want.

plugins.name: opus-refiner
plugins.description: Applies Anthropic's Opus 5.5 guidance: stop rules, destructive-command prompts, and skills for long runs, reviews, and checks.

plugins.name: code-review-flow
plugins.description: A code review process for agent-written code, based on how the Claude Code team reviews: verify first, vote on findings, tag severity, cap rounds, scale approval by risk, and turn incidents into evals.

plugins.name: trilemma
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: three suggested next prompts, quick follow-up pills, and a one-line usage strip for context and rate limits.

plugins.name: stepack
plugins.description: Plain, exact English for your agent: ASD-STE100 voice skills and lean-code skills.
